statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); if [ -n "$used" ]; then printf "%s | ctx: %.0f%% used | \$%.2f" "$model" "$used" "$cost"; else printf "%s | \$%.2f" "$model" "$cost"; fi
